data.name: Anoush
data.gender_notes: Anoush is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word ‘anoushana’, meaning 'graceful' or 'pleasing'. This name is a reflection of inner beauty and charm. The name Anoush carries the meaning “Graceful, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Anoush usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the beauty of the soul.
data.etymology: Anoush belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Pleasing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anoush total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
